about: Weights and anchor points for the JalSetu water-risk score. Each component is scaled to 0–100 by linear interpolation between its 'low' (0 risk) and 'high' (100 risk) anchors, then weighted. Weights must sum to 1. Methodology: docs/water-risk-methodology.md

rainfall.why: 0% = normal season; −60% is IMD's 'large deficient' boundary.

groundwater.indicator: Stage of groundwater extraction, Bengaluru Urban (%)
groundwater.why: CGWB categories: up to 70% safe, above 100% over-exploited.

reservoir.why: JalSetu planning choice: 80%+ full = comfortable, 20% or less = severe.

demand.why: JalSetu planning choice: 0% gap = no pressure, 40% gap = maximum pressure.

quality.indicator: Lake quality index (% of monitored lakes failing, blended with % in worst class)
quality.why: Average of (share of lakes not in KSPCB class A–C) and (share in class E).

community.indicator: Verified community reports in the last 30 days
community.why: Only admin-verified reports count, so spam cannot move the score.
